script.code:
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(n.t, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS db_now,
       CAST(h.id AS CHAR) AS ia_id, h.item_assembly_status, h.ia_v2_job_id AS ia_v2_job_id, h.stock_movement_no,
       (SELECT p.result_ref
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_ref,
       (SELECT p.step_name
          FROM gd_publish_step p
         WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
           AND p.job_id = 'IAC|{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}'
           AND p.step_name LIKE 'LOCK|%' AND p.is_deleted = 0
         ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS lock_step
  FROM (SELECT NOW(3) AS t) n
  LEFT JOIN sm_item_assembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(h.id AS CHAR), 'item_id', h.item_id, 'item_qty', h.item_qty, 'item_uom', CAST(h.item_uom AS CHAR),
       'location_id', CAST(h.location_id AS CHAR), 'inventory_category', h.inventory_category, 'batch_no', h.batch_no,
       'issuing_operation_faci', CAST(h.issuing_operation_faci AS CHAR), 'organization_id', h.organization_id,
       'stock_movement_no', h.stock_movement_no, 'stock_movement_no_type', CAST(h.stock_movement_no_type AS CHAR),

script.code:
SELECT CAST(m.id AS CHAR) AS id, m.transaction_type, m.movement, m.trx_no, CAST(m.item_id AS CHAR) AS item_id,
       CAST(m.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id, CAST(m.bin_location_id AS CHAR) AS bin_location_id, CAST(m.batch_number_id AS CHAR) AS batch_number_id,
       CAST(m.handling_unit_id AS CHAR) AS handling_unit_id, m.inventory_category, m.quantity, m.base_qty, CAST(m.uom_id AS CHAR) AS uom_id,
       CAST(m.base_uom_id AS CHAR) AS base_uom_id, m.unit_price, m.total_price, m.costing_method_id
  FROM inventory_movement m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND m.id > {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}
   AND m.organization_id = (SELECT h.organization_id FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}})
   AND m.trx_no = (SELECT h.stock_movement_no FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}})
   AND m.transaction_type IN ('IA', 'IA-R')
   AND m.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY m.id

SELECT JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(b.id AS CHAR), 'batch_number', b.batch_number, 'material_id', CAST(b.material_id AS CHAR),
       'plant_id', CAST(b.plant_id AS CHAR), 'organization_id', b.organization_id, 'transaction_no', b.transaction_no) AS j
  FROM batch b
  JOIN sm_item_assembly h
    ON h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}
   AND h.is_deleted = 0
 WHERE b.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND b.transaction_no = h.stock_movement_no
   AND b.organization_id = h.organization_id
   AND b.is_deleted = 0
 ORDER BY b.id

script.code:
SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT h.material_hold_status FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}) <> '' THEN JSON_OBJECT(
       'hold', (SELECT h.material_hold_status FROM sm_item_assembly h WHERE h.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND h.id = {{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}),
       'rows', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(r.id AS CHAR), 'status', r.status, 'doc_line_id', r.doc_line_id, 'material_id', CAST(r.material_id AS CHAR),
                'bin_location', CAST(r.bin_location AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(r.batch_id AS CHAR), 'from_category', r.from_category, 'open_qty', CAST(r.open_qty AS CHAR),
                'item_uom', CAST(r.item_uom AS CHAR)))
                FROM on_reserved_gd r WHERE r.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND r.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.doc_type = 'Item Assembly'
                 AND r.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}' AND r.status IN ('Allocated', 'Processing', 'Releasing')),
       'delivered', (SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT('id', CAST(d.id AS CHAR), 'material_id', CAST(d.material_id AS CHAR),
                'bin_location', CAST(d.bin_location AS CHAR), 'batch_id', CAST(d.batch_id AS CHAR), 'from_category', d.from_category,
                'delivered_qty', CAST(d.delivered_qty AS CHAR), 'item_uom', CAST(d.item_uom AS CHAR)))
                FROM on_reserved_gd d WHERE d.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND d.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.organizationId}}' AND d.is_deleted = 0 AND d.doc_type = 'Item Assembly'
                 AND d.doc_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}' AND d.status = 'Delivered'),
       'live', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM gd_publish_step p WHERE p.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}' AND p.job_id = 'IAH|{{node:code_node_IVPentry.data.iaId}}' AND p.step_name LIKE 'TICKET|%' AND p.step_status = 'HELD'
                 AND p.is_deleted = 0 AND p.started_at > CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), '+00:00', '+08:00') - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)) ELSE JSON_OBJECT('hold', '', 'rows',
		NULL, 'delivered', NULL, 'live', 0) END AS j

script.code:
SELECT CAST(f.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(f.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       f.fifo_cost_price,
       f.fifo_initial_quantity,
       f.fifo_available_quantity,
       f.fifo_sequence
FROM fifo_costing_history f
WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
  AND f.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.iaIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND f.plant_id = CAST('{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.plantIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.assembledIdsCsv}})
  AND f.is_deleted = 0

SELECT CAST(w.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       CAST(w.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(w.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       w.wa_quantity,
       w.wa_cost_price
FROM wa_costing_method w
WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
  AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.plantIdSql}}'
  AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.assembledIdsCsv}})
  AND w.is_deleted = 0
  AND (w.batch_id IS NULL OR w.id > CAST('{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.iaIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED))

script.code:
SELECT 'FIFO' AS t, CAST(f.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM fifo_costing_history f
WHERE f.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
  AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND f.plant_id = CAST('{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.plantIdSql}}' AS UNSIGNED)
  AND f.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND f.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY f.material_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 'WA' AS t, CAST(w.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM wa_costing_method w
WHERE w.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPguard.data.tenantId}}'
  AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.orgSql}}'
  AND w.plant_id = '{{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.plantIdSql}}'
  AND w.material_id IN ({{node:code_node_IVPprep.data.itemIdsCsv}})
  AND w.is_deleted = 0
GROUP BY w.material_id
